## Coverage and test-design implications

Cover every acceptance criterion under REQ-001 through REQ-014 with stable TC-NNN IDs, each linked to existing REQ and TASK identifiers, concrete preconditions, test data, steps, and observable expected results. Since the contract has no dedicated preconditions or test-data fields, put these explicitly in the case steps and/or title, without adding schema properties. Check observed sign-in content and navigation; equivalent public responses for existing, nonexistent, and throttled requests; first/fifth/sixth issuance and the exact rolling-hour boundary; valid reset, unknown/used/expired link rejection, 30-minute boundary and GET-before-expired-POST; session revocation and other-account isolation; per-success in-memory notification and failure rollback; runtime, documentation, automated pytest coverage, and absence of deployment. Include invalid input, CSRF/authorization boundaries, concurrent reuse, keyboard/labels/errors for proposed screens, and private token handling where linked to approved tasks. Do not present proposed checks as executed results.

## Evidence limits and open choices

There is no verified application implementation, test suite, runnable command, deployment record, real notification delivery, or production security assessment in the supplied evidence; cases are prospective. The image alone cannot justify exact recovery-screen visuals or a full sign-in policy. The solution design proposes minimal synthetic sign-in, a private outbox, a rolling 3600-second window with private nonexistent-key counting, and a minimal documented password-input rule; its open questions leave exact password rule, copy, and link inspection UX unresolved. Use design-proposed behavior without asserting these choices as image-observed or externally mandated. A negative deployment check can inspect deliverables and records but cannot prove a global absence of deployment beyond the reviewed scope. No untested requirement should be silently discarded: any untestable criterion needs an explicit justified coverage disposition or an open question.
